job.title: Software Engineer, DevAI
job.pay_full: $162,000 – $190,000 a year base pay; the role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits and Employee Travel Credits

details.about: Airbnb's Dev AI team builds the AI tooling and infrastructure that boosts developer productivity across the whole software development lifecycle, and gives teams across the company the building blocks to create their own AI tools. It works both as a platform team and as an internal AI consultancy for partner teams. The work ranges from agentic coding tools and asynchronous AI workflow platforms to SDKs for fast internal AI app development and AI-assisted code migration. The team describes itself as collaborative, low-ego and highly visible, moving with startup-like speed.
duties: Help shape and drive the AI for Developers strategy from idea to shipping, coding across various stacks
Make pragmatic architecture and technical decisions that balance ambition with real-world limits and long-term operability
Keep up with fast-moving AI tooling and balance innovation with measurable developer impact
Act as an expert, coach and consultant helping teams across the company adopt new AI capabilities
Champion engineering excellence through high-quality code, thoughtful design and reliable systems
Take part in on-call rotations and drive operational excellence for the team's platform
needs: 2+ years of industry experience (or equivalent depth of expertise)
Experience building developer infrastructure, tooling or platforms, ideally at scale
Hands-on experience applying AI technologies to real-world software development challenges
A track record of ramping up quickly in new domains, technologies or languages
Cross-functional partnership and excellent written and verbal communication
Proficiency in one or more of Go, Python, TypeScript or Kotlin
Bachelor's and/or Master's degree or equivalent experience
details.benefits: Base pay range $162,000 – $190,000 USD a year; actual base pay depends on training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits and Employee Travel Credits.
notes: US - Remote Eligible: you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity (Airbnb keeps an up-to-date list of excluded states)
May include occasional work at an Airbnb office or offsites, as agreed with your manager
Airbnb offers reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities
